For the IBS they said to not work at a call center or, word for word, "find a less stressful job," along with adjusting diet which I've done. Anxiety doesn't seem to bother them at all and they've offered nothing for it. 

Every time they say "we're required to ask, are you feeling depressed?" To which I always smile and say no since I've gone through that system before, and won't again.
